title: West Bengal: Babri Mosque Construction Begins In Murshidabad; Babri-Themed Merchandise Being Sold
text: West Bengal: Babri Mosque Construction Begins In Murshidabad; Babri-Themed Merchandise Being SoldConstruction has begun on the proposed Babri Masjid in West Bengal’s Murshidabad, two months after the foundation stone was laid on December 6 last year. Heavy machinery and building material have reached the site. Suspended TMC MLA Humayun Kobir said the mosque will be completed within two years. Alongside the construction, Babri-themed merchandise, including cups and T-shirts with “I Love Babri” slogans, is being sold at the site, intensifying the provocation.
